analyst_view.overall: Early view: Eyupspor are bottom with one win and three goals in eleven games under Mustafa Dalci, and they are already well adrift. Basaksehir (8th) under Nuri Sahin have won three of their last four, scoring seven in the last two, and host Corum six days earlier.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.8 goals. Eyupspor's expected 1.0 looks high for a side with three goals all season, but Basaksehir's 1.8 looks low against a defence that has conceded 30, so the total stays about the same, mostly from the away side.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.1 corners. Basaksehir should dominate the ball, which pushes their share up and Eyupspor's down, leaving the total close to nine.

cards.text: The numbers say 3.6 cards and I lean lower. Basaksehir should control the ball and have little reason to foul, and no suspensions or flashpoints are reported for either side.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots. I expect more from Basaksehir than 13.2 and fewer from Eyupspor than 11.5, so the total is about right.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.2 shots on target and I lean slightly lower, because Eyupspor's 4.0 looks generous for a team scoring fewer than one goal every three games.
